['Pfeifer & Langen GmbH & Co. KG '].company_description: Pfeifer & Langen GmbH & Co. KG is a German company, the largest sugar producer in the world, with an annual production of around 4.8 million tonnes.

['Takkt AG '].company_description: Takkt AG is a subsidiary of TAKKT AG, an online business-to-business wholesaler that markets its products mainly to retail stores and trade shows. The company offers a range of products including store fixtures, trade show supplies, retail media, and digital marketing products.
